Meaning: A grouping of PLC data by the kind of object it belongs to. Each interface is one aggregate: its members travel together and map to one WinCC OA DPType.
How many instances of the interface exist on SafeStack, and so how many DPs of its DPType.
The PLC data block that holds the member. A placeholder stands for one block per instance.
Path of the value inside its PLC block.
What the value is for, seen from the HMI. Role decides the WinCC OA direction.
Owned by the PLC. The HMI only reads it.
Owned by the HMI but held by the PLC, which can change it without the HMI knowing - a restart, a start value, a program write. The HMI writes it and must read it back.
A request from the HMI that the PLC consumes. Either the PLC or the HMI clears it; nothing needs reading back.
Whether the PLC keeps the value through a restart. A non-retain Setting returns to its start value on restart, which is one reason Settings are read back.
Logical flow, in PLC handover language.
Values: HMI to PLC, PLC to HMI

Meaning: Address mode of the DPE's peripheral address, in WinCC OA language. Follows from Role.
Where the value lives in WinCC OA: the DPE that carries the peripheral address. The value's entry point. Written as sheet.DPElement.
The panel that uses the value. Names a PNLMAP sheet.
The shape or panel reference on the panel that uses the value.
The shape event whose script touches the value.
What the script does with the DPE. Replaces v1 Read, which did not say whether the value is followed after the first read.
One-shot read (dpGet). Suits a Setting shown when a panel opens.
Continuous read (dpConnect). Required for any Status the operator watches change.
Write (dpSet).
Explicit marker for a binding not yet known. Kept so unresolved links can be counted rather than silently missing.
